column.head: Picks are in for Wednesday
paras: Mr. JuiceBox here, fully hydrated and fully modeled.
Nothing graded from last night. Clean slate.

lines.text: Merv found nothing he trusts tonight. He's going to bed at seven.
Leslie's sitting this one out. Not enough points on the board for her taste.
Brett's board is empty. The machine says nothing, so Brett says nothing.
No home dog in the Shark's window tonight. He says he's 'visiting a friend.'

column.close: Season ledger starts tonight. Everybody's even.
